name: wallet-by-budgetbakers
description: Wallet by BudgetBakers helps users review transactions, accounts, categories, labels, budgets, and related financial data, analyze spending, and create, update, or delete bookkeeping data through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Wallet by BudgetBakers helps users review transactions, accounts, categories, labels, budgets, and related financial data, analyze spending, and create, update, or delete bookkeeping data through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Where did my money actually go last month?
Compare my spending this month to the same month last year.
Show me my largest unusual expenses in the last 3 months.

positive.description: Check my account balances in Wallet.
positive.prompt: What are my account balances in Wallet?
positive.expected_behavior: Three accounts listed — Main Checking 4,312.97 EUR, Savings 6,000.00 EUR, Cash 202.10 EUR; total 10,515.07 EUR.

positive.description: Spending analysis for a specific month.
positive.prompt: How much did I spend in each category in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Rent 950.00 · Groceries 315.75 · Energy & utilities 118.00 · Fuel 70.20 · Restaurants & fast food 39.80 · Public transport 27.50 · TV, streaming 13.99 · Bar cafe 12.40. Total 1,547.64 EUR. The 500 EUR savings transfer is not counted as spending.

positive.description: Adding a new expense to an existing account
positive.prompt: Add a 42.80 EUR grocery expense at Lidl today to my Main Checking account
positive.expected_behavior: One expense created: −42.80 EUR, category Groceries, counter party Lidl, account Main Checking, dated today. The Monthly Groceries budget for the current month increases by 42.80

positive.prompt: How am I doing on my Monthly Groceries budget in September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: 315.75 of 400 EUR spent (≈79%), 84.25 EUR remaining, not overspent. Optional comparison: August 264.80 EUR spent.

positive.prompt: Show me everything I spent on my Vacation trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Two records: Booking.com −620.00 (Hotel in Rome, Main Checking, 18 Aug 2026) and Trattoria Roma −58.00 (Dinner in Rome, Cash, 19 Aug 2026). Total 678.00 EUR.

negative.description: Live exchange rates are outside Wallet's scope.
negative.prompt: What's today's EUR to USD exchange rate?
negative.expected_behavior: Wallet is not invoked. ChatGPT answers from web search or general knowledge.

negative.description: Credit scores are not data Wallet holds.
negative.expected_behavior: Wallet is not invoked. ChatGPT explains that a credit score comes from a credit bureau or bank and suggests where to check it.

negative.description: Wallet records money but cannot make payments.
negative.prompt: Send 100 EUR to my friend Jan from my checking account.
negative.expected_behavior: No Wallet write tool is called. ChatGPT explains that Wallet tracks money but can't make payments or bank transfers, and that the payment has to be made in the user's banking app. It may offer to record the payment in Wallet only if the user asks.

publication.release_notes: Update the displayed developer name from JAN MULLER to BudgetBakers.
